steps.text: 9:09 A.M. \ Overcast
Port 309, Sudean Borough, Londinium

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The port... is right ahead.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Hm... Actually, things have been going pretty well so far...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: With one exception.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor, the Messenger who's been in contact with you and Dr. Kal'tsit should've reached out to us as soon as we arrived at the adjacent plate.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We're just waiting here... with our hands tied behind our backs.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I thought we'd be able to see her in person, or at least get some kind of message.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor, I can't say any more about our current situation to the other operators.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We've already gotten this far, so we can only keep moving forward.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: If we can't get in touch, we can't know for sure.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But I can only hope that nothing happened to her...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We'll enter the city as we originally planned.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Ugh, look at how long that line is. They're all coming from the direction of the city...

steps.name: Londinium Citizen A
steps.text: We're really going to run away like this?

steps.name: Londinium Citizen B
steps.text: This way's safe. My neighbor's whole family left this way last week.

steps.name: Londinium Citizen B
steps.text: As long as we've applied for an exit permit, the soldiers won't give us any trouble.

steps.name: Londinium Citizen A
steps.text: That... That's not what I meant.

steps.name: Londinium Citizen B
steps.text: I know. We're thinking the same thing.

steps.name: Londinium Citizen B
steps.text: Four years ago was when I first heard about the Sarkaz army on the news. Didn't think much of it back then.

steps.name: Londinium Citizen A
steps.text: Yeah, same here. With Her Majesty gone, everything's turned to shit. Who could've expected that some duke would invite the devils into the army on a whim?

steps.name: Londinium Citizen B
steps.text: Two years ago, I saw Sarkaz troops walking down the streets of Trenfield. Everyone was talking about it as we walked home from work.

steps.name: Londinium Citizen A
steps.text: I also remember... It was as if things quietly changed overnight. Those of us who lived by the duke's estate in Camden wouldn't see these changes until a bit later.

steps.name: Londinium Citizen B
steps.text: Something like half a year ago, the Sarkaz army stood in front of our bank. They took away our manager because her husband held an important position in the city's defense forces.

steps.name: Londinium Citizen A
steps.text: Whew. Did you ever see them again? The police force in our estate was replaced with all new faces, plenty with horrible horns on top.

steps.name: Londinium Citizen B
steps.text: And then there's... yesterday. I saw the Sarkaz going to the corner opposite my home. They were... knocking on doors.

steps.name: Londinium Citizen A
steps.text: So that's why you decided to flee?

steps.name: Londinium Citizen B
steps.text: Actually, my parents left a long time ago. I just... couldn't put down my banker's salary.

steps.name: Londinium Citizen A
steps.text: None of us wanted this. Londinium... If we leave, we'll never be able to go back to our old lives, right?

steps.name: Londinium Citizen B
steps.text: Let's not worry about that for now. We should get going. I'd rather stay alive than make money.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Is it like this every day?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: More or less, since a certain point.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Theresis's army... They're not stopping the civilians from leaving the city?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: By the looks of things, he doesn't seem to care about letting outsiders know who holds the reins of power in Londinium now.

options: And the other nobles don't care?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I'd assume they always have an eye on Londinium, which is why they have troops stationed outside the city.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: But they're more concerned about watching each others' moves.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: For the dukes who've been trying to get into Londinium, whoever gets ahead in taking down the Sarkaz inside the city will gain the upper hand in this power struggle that has lasted over twenty years.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Who would want to see the throne claimed by someone else, when in their minds, it rightfully belongs to them?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: The way things are now, anything a duke might pull can be stopped by a few messages, an invitation to a party, or even a little bad news from their own demesne.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: And even if one of them decided to march on the city, they'd be walking right into a defeat. The Sarkaz regent wouldn't lose a single man.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I'm not sure.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: When we left Londinium, the city seemed like it did on any ordinary day.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: And I always figured that if Parliament could convene for a day, nothing too crazy could happen to Londinium.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: As for the specifics of what's going on inside the city, we won't know until we see for ourselves.

steps.name: Londinium Citizen
steps.text: Excuse me, I've brought you all the way here... You'll be able to go the rest of the way on your own, right?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Yes, sure. Thank you, Mr. Thomas. You've done us a great favor.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: All squads, listen up. Follow the plan and mingle with the flow of traffic ahead in batches––

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Closure's squad will go first to make sure the road ahead of us is clear. Then Siege's squad will follow up, with me and Doctor's squad behind that.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Recon squad, keep a close eye on our surroundings, and report any abnormalities right away.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Balin, you'll be in charge of taking Mr. Thomas back the same way we came.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Amiya!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: There's a disturbance up ahead! Looks like Sarkaz fighters incoming!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: What?!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Everyone, the infiltration operation is on hold. Take cover, hide yourselves!

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Grab that one, right there!

steps.name: Londinium Citizen A
steps.text: What... What's going on? Why are the Sarkaz here?

steps.name: Londinium Citizen A
steps.text: Didn't you say this way was safe?!

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: I'm talking to you. Stop right there!

steps.name: Londinium Citizen A
steps.text: Hurry... Hurry... We're almost out... of the city...

steps.name: Londinium Citizen A
steps.text: Gaaahh––!

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Wrong one.

steps.name: Londinium Citizen B
steps.text: S-Sir, please... D-Don't hurt me, I'll go... Did we do something wrong?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Go, scurry off. Don't stand here blocking our way.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Listen up, nobody move!

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Stop what you're doing and stand still. You, you, and you. Turn around and let me see your face!

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: What's in your bag? Is it a weapon? Pour everything out and let me see!

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Why's there a burn mark on your face? Looks pretty fresh too... Yeah, you. Get out of the line!

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: You burned your face baking bread? Do you take us for fools?!

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Hmph... Guess it really wasn't our weapons. Just to be sure, you're not a rebel, right?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Got too scared and passed out, huh? Whatever, we'll bring this one with us.

steps.name: Londinium Citizen?
steps.text: Lieutenant, we're stuck here.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: It's my fault. Before I brought you here, I should've made sure we weren't being followed.

steps.name: Londinium Citizen?
steps.text: Please don't talk like that.

steps.name: Londinium Citizen?
steps.text: We've all been through worse. Whether it's my bunch that got captured by Dublinn, or Old Tom's group who were tortured by the Sarkaz, we were pretty much dead men walking until you rescued us.

steps.name: Londinium Citizen?
steps.text: That really was a taste of despair... I'd rather die in battle than live inside the enemy's cage, powerless and addled.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: You are not to blame for Londinium's fall, not in the slightest.

steps.name: Londinium Citizen?
steps.text: And you are even less to blame.

steps.name: Londinium Citizen?
steps.text: You were the one who pulled us out of a desperate situation. At least I was able to get here on my own two legs, and got to live an extra hour.

steps.name: Londinium Citizen?
steps.text: I said I didn't have the will to fight anymore, but you didn't blame me. You even risked yourself to bring us here.

steps.name: Londinium Citizen?
steps.text: Leave us, Lieutenant. If you're alone, you can hide. Avoid their line of sight, and find a safe place.

steps.name: Londinium Citizen?
steps.text: We're sickly and chewed up. We'll only slow you down.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: I'd never leave any of you behind.

steps.name: Londinium Citizen?
steps.text: Hah... If our officers back there were like you, then maybe... we wouldn't have lost so quickly and disastrously.

steps.name: Londinium Citizen?
steps.text: It took meeting you to make me realize that I wanted to make a difference, to be like you...

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: You mean... No, you mustn't!

steps.name: Londinium Citizen?
steps.text: Hey, if the few of us charged at once, how many Sarkaz do you reckon we could take with us?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Listen to me, right now.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: None of you move. That's an order.

steps.name: Londinium Citizen?
steps.text: An order...?

steps.name: Londinium Citizen?
steps.text: Fine. You're my commanding officer right now. I'll obey your orders.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: We still have a few minutes until we face the Sarkaz.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Keep your heads down. Remember what I told you – you're all vagrants from the neighboring estate. You got hurt fighting each other over a piece of bread.

steps.name: Londinium Citizen?
steps.text: You... expect the Sarkaz to buy that?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Sudean is a complete mess these days. They've probably seen it all.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Doesn't matter if they buy it or not. Even if they try to interrogate you, just... bear with it for a while.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: And if you can't take it anymore...

steps.name: Londinium Citizen?
steps.text: We understand. If the Sarkaz find out, no one betrays the others.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: If you can't take it anymore, that's when I'll make my move.

steps.name: Londinium Citizen?
steps.text: Lieutenant...?!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Let's wait and see for now.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Nothing over here.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: What about over there? There are a few more over there, and behind that elevator too. This damned place has too many hiding spots!

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: You lot, go take a closer look over there!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Those fighters seem to be looking for someone.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Squads, report your current position.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Positions confirmed.

options: They don't seem to be after us.
Think we haven't been made yet.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Seems like it.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor, do you still remember the table-top exercise we did with Dr. Kal'tsit before we left?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: One possibility is that the Messengers we had active around Londinium and Victoria all failed.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: They didn't have time to provide us with the accurate intel, and Theresis was able to see all our moves.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: In that case, Theresis's personal guard would be there waiting for us the moment we set foot in Londinium.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But it doesn't look like that's what's happening...

options: Actually, I thought it'd be a Confessarius.
Surely we wouldn't be that incompetent?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I think we've more or less reached the same conclusion.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Theresis doesn't know we're here yet. Otherwise, we would've had a very hard time even making it this far.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: If that's true, then these Sarkaz fighters up ahead must be searching for someone else who could potentially come this way...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Huh, Mr. Thomas...?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Amiya, he tried to bolt! I barely managed to stop him!

steps.name: Londinium Citizen
steps.text: No, let me go! I can't stay here...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Mr. Thomas, you'd best not run off on your own! That'd be terribly dangerous!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I promised you I'd send an operator to escort you... I'm really sorry, but that's not something we can do right now...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Ouch!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: W-Wait, you can't just take our operator's weapon––!

steps.name: Londinium Citizen
steps.text: Sorry, b-but, I don't want to die!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: What's going on here...?

options: He thinks the Sarkaz are after him.

steps.name: Londinium Citizen
steps.text: I don't want this either... I was just their driver for six months, that's all!

steps.name: Londinium Citizen
steps.text: They took over my candy plant and forced me to ship things for them. I have a family... what am I supposed to do?!

steps.name: Londinium Citizen
steps.text: That day I took a tiny peek, just one glance. How could I have known what they were doing with my plant?

steps.name: Londinium Citizen
steps.text: They've been chasing me ever since! If they catch me, they're going to kill me for sure!

steps.name: Londinium Citizen
steps.text: Why'd you have me do this anyway... I'm going to die, no matter where I run!

steps.name: Londinium Citizen
steps.text: I... I can't just sit here and wait to die...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Mr. Thomas!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Balin! Don't chase after him, we can't afford to blow our cover.

steps.name: Londinium Citizen
steps.text: Ha... Haha...

steps.name: Londinium Citizen
steps.text: I'll just... keep running away from Londinium... I don't even care about Dublinn anymore...
Huh?

steps.name: Londinium Citizen
steps.text: Eek––!

steps.name: Londinium Citizen
steps.text: You... How could... You're...

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: It's not up to you to decide whether or not you care about Dublinn.

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: ––Get him.
